concerns.text: SC-004 states “Multiple‑comparison correction is measured against the unadjusted p‑values to quantify family‑wise error rate control” but does not define a concrete, observable metric (e.g., report adjusted p‑values and the count of hypotheses that change significance). Without a measurable definition the criterion cannot be automatically verified.

FR-007 requires the system to “frame joint relationships descriptively rather than claiming independent predictive effects” when VIF ≥ 10. The spec does not specify a verifiable output format (e.g., a JSON report listing collinear predictor groups and a free‑text summary). The subjective nature of “descriptive framing” makes automated verification ambiguous.
